title: MapleStory Classic Cleric Build and Leveling Guide: Lv 30-70
intro: Clerics heal their party, buff Accuracy with Bless, and fire Holy Arrow at mobs. Max Holy Arrow first for your regular attack, or start with Heal for early healing and undead training.

blocks.p: Our level 70 damage numbers use the gear from Grummash's level 70 Cleric build.

ul: #1 in Physical EHP and tied #1 in Magical EHP in our level 70 benchmarks: you're extremely tanky.
Heal and Bless support nearby party members; Invincible reduces the damage you take when monsters touch you.
Holy Arrow can focus three arrows on one mob or split them across three.
Bless gives nearby party members up to 20 Accuracy and 20 Evasion.
Teleport keeps you moving between platforms.

blocks.p: **Cons**

ul: Lowest damage amongst all classes at level 70.
Holy Arrow and Heal targeting can be confusing and frustrating.
Heal is reduced by the number of enemy targets and party members.

blocks.p: This guide picks up from our Magician level 1 to 30 guide, which compares first-job builds by meso cost. Any of these works for a Cleric.

Safer moves 12 SP from Magic Armor to Magic Guard. Meso saver is the level 30 build from Grummash's Cleric Meso Management Guide and goes with the solo play order below. Grummash's level 70 build is aimed at endgame bossing and uses Magic Claw for levels 10 to 40.

ul: [[img:32b086d39a1fbe.png]]Magic Armor **Take it first.** Lv14 gives +92 Weapon and Magic Defense for 495 seconds; Lv16 gives +100 for 525 seconds.

[[img:211a115f0a6318.png]]Magic Guard **Raise it later.** Lv13 moves 74% of a hit to MP and Lv15 moves 80%. Raise it when single hits get big enough to threaten you. Moving damage to MP costs more mesos to refill, so it buys safety.

blocks.p: We recommend Kerning City from levels 30 to 70. Its robe scrolls can help you reach a LUK requirement or add more INT. The shop discounts also help while your mesos are going into MP recovery.
Accuracy is useful only when it changes a miss into a hit. Every miss still costs MP and an attack animation, so your EXP per minute drops quickly.

blocks.h2: Levels 30-70: Cleric skill build and leveling

ol: Start the second-job advancement with Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia.
Bring his letter to the Magician Job Instructor at the very top of The Forest North of Ellinia.
Finish the combat test and turn 30 Dark Marbles into The Proof of a Hero.
Take the proof back to Grendel and choose Cleric.

blocks.p: [[img:fb4af958a97eb5.png]] **Grendel the Really Old** Starts and finishes the Cleric advancement in Ellinia.
[[img:9a7face47a910e.png]] **Magician Job Instructor** Runs the Dark Marble test north of Ellinia.

blocks.note: **Party build: start Holy Arrow at level 31, but keep attacking with Energy Bolt until about level 38.** Holy Arrow's lowest roll overtakes Energy Bolt 20 at skill Lv18 (level 37) against Zombie Mushrooms and Jr. Wraith, and Lv24 (level 39) against Horny Mushrooms. At level 40, Holy Arrow 28 reaches about 4,860 EXP/min in Training Advisor against 3,240 for Energy Bolt. The solo play order keeps Energy Bolt until level 41 to save mesos.

blocks.p: For a Cleric who plays in a party. Holy Arrow comes first so you still level quickly. Invincible 5 and Bless 16 come next, so from level 49 everyone nearby gets +16 Accuracy, +16 Evasion, and 8% more Heal recovery. Heal is maxed after that. Invincible stays at 5 because it only protects you, and Teleport is maxed last for its 150 distance.

blocks.p: Second-job SP cannot be spent on first-job skills, so finish the first-job plan by level 30. Character Builder flags any build that breaks it.

blocks.h3: Solo Play Cleric SP allocation: levels 30-70

blocks.p: For a Cleric who mostly grinds alone, based on Grummash's Cleric Meso Management Guide without its level 41 SP reset. It starts from the Meso saver first-job build.

ul: [[img:761911536c6e3c.png]]Teleport **Stays at 1 until level 56.** One cast costs 55 MP; Heal 2 costs 12.
[[img:eac115898a2f1c.png]]Bless **Stays at 1.** Its bonus mainly helps a party.
[[img:94ac0043dcd64d.png]]Heal **Maxed last, for healing yourself.** It never cleared a training map on its own in Training Advisor.

table: Max the regular attack. Keep using Energy Bolt on Horny and Zombie Mushrooms until level 41, then switch to Holy Arrow on Jr. Wraith.

blocks.p: Training Advisor gives the Cleric the same maps and EXP either way at levels 45, 50, and 55, because every top map is Safe. Pick by how you play:

ul: [[img:eac115898a2f1c.png]]Bless **Party:** a physical party gets +16 Accuracy and misses less.
[[img:187c5ce975e66a.png]]Invincible **Solo:** you take less touch damage and use fewer potions.

blocks.h3: Party build vs solo build at level 70

blocks.p: **Both builds max Heal, Holy Arrow, MP Eater, and Teleport.** The party build moves 15 SP from Invincible into Bless.
Recovery Rate is the listed skill value and does not map to a share of Max HP. See how Heal shares its targets before choosing an undead map.
**Use your own skill levels in Training Advisor.** The map picks below follow the party order. Enter your own skill levels in Training Advisor for the solo order.
Keep base LUK at your level minus 10 and put everything else into INT for more damage, MP, and Accuracy. That meets Mithril Wand, Esther Shield, Fairy Wand, and Cromi on the level you can equip them.

At level 50, craft Green Goldwind Shoes with Tailoring Lv 10. Their +5 LUK covers Thorns, Evil Tale, Evil Wings, and Angel Wings as you reach each one. Skip Arc Staff: it needs 40 LUK at level 45, when this plan has 35, so stay on Fairy Wand until Cromi at 50.

table: Any class. 44 WDEF gives an 8.09% Guard chance, the best block rate for a mage.
Mage shield with 28 WDEF and 55 MDEF. Its 5.30% Guard chance is lower than Pan Lid's. Requires 60 INT and 25 LUK.
73 M.ATK. Requires 90 INT and 40 LUK. Skip it on this AP plan.

+5 LUK from Tailoring Lv 10. Requires 90 INT and 40 LUK. Covers the LUK on every weapon from here to Angel Wings.
111 M.ATK before scrolling. Requires 140 INT and 65 LUK.

blocks.p: Clerics can hold a shield with either a wand or a staff. Spell cast time does not change with weapon speed, so take the highest M.ATK you can equip. Pan Lid blocks more often than Esther Shield (8.09% against 5.30% Guard chance), while Esther Shield adds 55 MDEF against magic attacks. Every WDEF scroll on the shield raises Guard chance further.

blocks.h2: M.ATK or Critical Rate on gloves?

blocks.note: **Pick Magic Attack for this build.** Five successful Lesser M.ATK scrolls give Grummash's level 70 Cleric about 2.03% more expected damage than five Critical Rate scrolls.

blocks.p: It's all about the tradeoff. Both options use five glove slots. Critical Rate gives you more crits, but M.ATK wins on expected damage with this gear.

**+10 M.ATK**
301 to 311 total M.ATK
About 3.32% more expected damage.

**+5% Critical Rate**
9% to 14% Critical Rate
About 1.27% more expected damage.
W.ATK does not increase spell damage. A matching Magic Attack scroll gives twice as much M.ATK as the Critical Rate scroll gives Critical Rate.

**The ratio is the same at every grade.** Lesser gives +1 W.ATK or +1% Critical Rate (+2 M.ATK), Intermediate +2/+2% (+4 M.ATK), Greater +3/+3% (+6 M.ATK), and Chaos +4/+4% (+8 M.ATK). Matching grades have the same success and destruction rates.

blocks.h2: Example builds and Training Advisor maps

blocks.p: Each checkpoint has two picks, with danger and the nearest potion refill. If the EXP is close, take the safer map.

ul: [[img:24dcca787059a4.png]]Energy Bolt at level 30, [[img:ee22f70546674f.png]]Holy Arrow from level 41.
**Gear:** levels 41 to 60 wear the newest mage hat, overall, gloves, and shoes for that level, Esther Shield, and the weapon from the equipment table. Level 70 wears Grummash's gear.
**Guaranteed one-cast:** all three arrows kill the mob on the weakest roll, at a 100% hit rate.
[[img:94ac0043dcd64d.png]]Heal never gave a one- or two-cast map with these builds.

blocks.p: A crowded map or awkward platforms can cost you that EXP advantage. Pick the lower-EXP map if it has a drop you need.

blocks.p: **Before you settle in:** Ant Tunnel II beats Ant Tunnel III by one portal to the refill shop, with the same one-cast kills and danger at levels 50 and 60. Ten more levels alone is no reason to move.

**Why not Jr. Wraith at level 50?** By then Jr. Wraith dies to two of your three arrows, so focusing one wastes the third. Training Advisor counts that wasted arrow: Line 1 <Area 2> comes out at about 7,836 EXP/min and the Wraith maps at about 5,867. In Ant Tunnel II one arrow kills each mushroom, so nothing is wasted.
Holy Arrow fires three arrows. You can focus all three on one mob or split them across up to three. At max level, it has 60 Basic Attack and Mastery 10 for 28 MP.
**Our level 70 benchmark deals about 2,468 expected total damage on a neutral target and 3,086 against an undead target.**
Heal has six shared target slots. You and nearby party members take priority, leaving up to five for undead when solo. More targets means less damage per undead.

ul: **Heal 11:** 16 MP, 60% Recovery Rate.
**Grummash's tip:** step away from Zombie Mushrooms before you heal. Healing next to undead hits them, pulls them to you, and leaves less recovery for you.

blocks.p: See party build vs solo build for the skill values.
**For undead training, enter your Heal level and the number of nearby party members and undead in Training Advisor.**

Max Invincible cuts the damage you take from monster touches by 30% for 300 seconds and damages mobs that touch you. Max Bless gives nearby party members 20 Accuracy, 20 Evasion, and 10% more HP recovery from the Heal skill.

blocks.h3: Holy and undead on Victoria Island

blocks.p: Holy Arrow deals 25% more damage to holy-weak mobs. Heal only damages undead mobs. The two lists overlap, but they are different.

Green Mushrooms count as undead, so Heal hits them. Holy Arrow does normal damage to them. Malady and Dark Stone Golem are holy-weak without being undead, so Heal leaves them alone. Fairy 2, 3, and 4 resist holy.

MP Eater drains at most once every 5 seconds, and it gets nothing from mobs with 0 MP. On Victoria Island that means Pig, Ribbon Pig, Wild Boar, Ligator, and Fire Boar. Every undead mob on Victoria Island has MP, and so does every mob on the maps this guide recommends.

blocks.h2: Find your build's best training map with Training Advisor

blocks.p: The Training Advisor recommends the best map based on your level, equipment, and expected EXP efficiency.
**Danger measures how hard a mob hits you for: under 10% of your HP is Safe, 10-24% is Caution, 25-49% is Danger, and 50%+ is Lethal.**

ol: Load your exact setup in Character Builder.
Set 100% hit rate. Use Holy Arrow, or enter the party and undead target counts when you test Heal.
Leave Factor Danger into recommendations enabled. Enter your actual Magic Guard and Invincible skill levels.
Compare the best one- or two-cast maps. Check danger and distance from a potion shop before choosing.

blocks.cap: Grummash's saved Cleric in Training Advisor: compare hit rate and expected EXP. Check damage and danger against your refill distance.
